rationale: The workflow already implements the dependency-cache optimization (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) via Swatinem/rust-cache@v2, and the matrix already preserves full coverage (build, fmt, clippy) with fail-fast: false. The remaining candidate, P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout), is not supported: ci_history reports measurement as "not_a_measured_baseline" with only two runs (~7-8 min each) and variable cold-start cost from xtensa-toolchain download/cache restore, so there is no representative successful-duration history to set a safe limit; imposing one risks failing valid slow/cold runs, which is the pattern's stated contraindication. Test/build selection or skipping patterns would reduce the intended build+fmt+clippy coverage, which must be preserved. No unrelated or privileged changes are warranted.
